_note: SAMPLE policies for the demo fleet, illustrative terms only (not real policies or quotes). Real policies come from the operator's broker: hull & machinery, war risks, P&I club entry, and their trading warranties.
listed_area_rule: War-risk policies normally exclude JWC listed areas unless the owner notifies underwriters and pays an additional premium; underwriters can cancel war cover on 7 days' notice.

gulf_guinea.text: Trading warranty excludes the Gulf of Guinea; held covered at an additional premium
